headline: Tunisia: arbitration worth $573 million between the State and Zenith Energy suspended
summary: Canadian group Zenith Energy said on November 24, 2026 it suspended arbitration by three British subsidiaries against Tunisia at ICSID over the $573 million claim, alleging unpaid advances.
why: Zenith Energy is a Canadian energy group, and ICSID is the World Bank body that handles investor-state disputes, which matter for investment risk in emerging markets.
original_headline: Tunisie : suspension de l’arbitrage à 573 millions de dollars opposant l’État à Zenith Energy
